name: Grand Piano with Bench
summary: Original glossy baby grand with open/closed lids, a lightweight 88-note keyboard and separate sittable bench.
description: Brand-neutral P1 black-lacquer baby grand for S15: curved bentside, brass-colored harp, three pedals and castered legs. One GLB contains lid_open/lid_closed variants, a separate bench and hidden collision proxies.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry; two shared materials with local vertex colors; no textures, external assets or text.

display.origin: Floor centre of the complete piano-and-bench footprint

keyboard.representation: one ivory slab and 87 flat quads

accuracy_notes: glTF XYZ dimensions (width, height, depth): complete set 1.50 x 1.031 x 2.00 m closed; raised lid needs 1.812 m vertical clearance. Flat 88-note pattern A0-C8, not playable key solids. Core glTF has no visibility flag: lid_closed is stored in opt-in VARIANT_LidClosed, collision proxies in opt-in COLLISION_ONLY; neither renders in the default scene. Bench is a separate floor-pivot node with a local seat anchor and facing direction; gameplay seating and collision registration remain the consuming application's responsibility. No audio, playable keys or continuous lid animation. Full S15 assembly, physical devices and hardware performance remain unverified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials; no external models, fonts, textures or logos.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

lid.mode: swap nodes under ASSET_GrandPiano; keep exactly one attached
